d01-foundations.desc_en: Terms, threat models and the basic questions of cryptography: build a language you can reuse.
d01-foundations.prereq_zh: 无。只要知道明文、密文、算法和密钥不是同一个东西。
d01-foundations.prereq_en: None. You only need to know that plaintext, ciphertext, algorithm and key are different things.
outcomes_zh: 分清密码学与密码分析各自回答什么问题。
写出一个可检验的威胁模型，而不是只说“防黑客”。
用 Kerckhoffs 原则判断一个方案的信任边界。
outcomes_en: Separate what cryptography and cryptanalysis each answer.
Write a testable threat model instead of saying “stop hackers”.
Use Kerckhoffs' principle to locate a scheme's trust boundary.
d01-foundations.project_zh: 给自己的一个日常通信场景写威胁模型：谁在听、谁能改、你要保护什么。
d01-foundations.project_en: Write a threat model for one everyday communication scenario: who listens, who can modify, and what you protect.

d02-monoalphabetic.desc_en: The monoalphabetic family: Caesar, affine, homophonic substitution, and why frequency analysis defeats them.
d02-monoalphabetic.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”。
outcomes_zh: 用模运算描述凯撒与仿射密码的加密、解密。
解释单表替换为什么保留字母频率。
对一段足够长的密文做频率分析并给出候选明文。
outcomes_en: Describe Caesar and affine encryption/decryption with modular arithmetic.
Explain why monoalphabetic substitution preserves letter frequencies.
Run frequency analysis on a long ciphertext and propose a candidate plaintext.
d02-monoalphabetic.project_zh: 手工破译一段 200 字以上的单表替换密文，并记录你的频率表与试错过程。
d02-monoalphabetic.project_en: Break a monoalphabetic ciphertext of 200+ characters by hand, recording your frequency table and trials.

d03-polyalphabetic.desc_en: Polyalphabetic substitution: Vigenère, Beaufort, Porta and how periodic keys fight letter frequency.
outcomes_zh: 说明多表替换如何打散单字母频率。
用 Kasiski 检验与重合指数估计密钥长度。
解释周期密钥为什么仍会留下结构。
outcomes_en: Explain how polyalphabetic substitution smears single-letter frequencies.
Estimate key length with Kasiski examination and index of coincidence.
Explain why periodic keys still leave structure.
d03-polyalphabetic.project_zh: 给一段维吉尼亚密文估计密钥长度，写出两种方法的交叉验证。
d03-polyalphabetic.project_en: Estimate the key length of a Vigenère ciphertext and cross-check with two methods.

d04-transposition.desc_en: Transposition and rail fence: keep the letters, change the order; permutation space and known plaintext.
outcomes_zh: 区分换位与替换：改变的是顺序还是字母。
用栅栏、列换位描述一个可逆排列。
解释已知明文如何缩小排列搜索空间。
outcomes_en: Distinguish transposition from substitution: order versus letters.
Describe a reversible permutation with rail fence or column transposition.
Explain how known plaintext reduces the permutation search space.
d04-transposition.project_zh: 设计一个两轮换位，并说明它为什么仍可能被字谜式分析攻破。
d04-transposition.project_en: Design a two-round transposition and explain why anagramming can still attack it.

d05-rotor-mechanical.desc_en: Rotors and mechanical cipher machines: Enigma, Purple, M-209, Lorenz and Typex.
d05-rotor-mechanical.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“多表替换”和“换位”。
d05-rotor-mechanical.prereq_en: Polyalphabetic Substitution and Transposition recommended first.
outcomes_zh: 说明转子、反射器、接线板各自改变什么。
解释 Enigma 的步进与自逆性质。
用已知明文/crib 说明机械密码的破译入口。
outcomes_en: Explain what rotors, reflector and plugboard each change.
Explain Enigma's stepping and self-reciprocal property.
Use a crib to explain the entry point into breaking a mechanical cipher.
d05-rotor-mechanical.project_zh: 画出一台简化转子机的加密流程，并标出三个最容易被利用的结构弱点。
d05-rotor-mechanical.project_en: Draw the encryption flow of a simplified rotor machine and mark three exploitable structural weaknesses.

d06-otp-stream.desc_en: One-time pad and stream ciphers: keystream, reuse, XOR and synchronisation.
d06-otp-stream.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”。
outcomes_zh: 写出 OTP 的完美保密条件。
解释流密码的密钥流与异或关系。
说明密钥流重用为什么会泄露明文关系。
outcomes_en: State the conditions for one-time-pad perfect secrecy.
Explain the keystream and XOR relationship in stream ciphers.
Explain why keystream reuse leaks relations between plaintexts.
d06-otp-stream.project_zh: 用两段重用密钥流的密文演示异或泄露，并写出修复方案。
d06-otp-stream.project_en: Demonstrate XOR leakage with two ciphertexts that reuse a keystream, then write the fix.

d07-cryptanalysis.desc_en: Cryptanalysis: frequency, index of coincidence, Kasiski, differential, linear and meet-in-the-middle.
d07-cryptanalysis.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“单表替换”“多表替换”“换位”。
d07-cryptanalysis.prereq_en: Monoalphabetic, Polyalphabetic and Transposition recommended first.
outcomes_zh: 区分唯密文、已知明文、选择明文、选择密文攻击。
说明频率分析与重合指数各自适合什么场景。
用差分/线性的直觉解释现代分组密码的攻击面。
outcomes_en: Distinguish ciphertext-only, known-plaintext, chosen-plaintext and chosen-ciphertext attacks.
Explain which scenarios frequency analysis and index of coincidence fit.
Use differential/linear intuition to explain modern block-cipher attack surfaces.
d07-cryptanalysis.project_zh: 选一段古典密文，写一份从频率表到候选明文的完整破译日志。
d07-cryptanalysis.project_en: Take a classical ciphertext and write a complete break log from frequency table to candidate plaintext.

d08-block-ciphers.desc_en: Block ciphers: DES, AES, SM4 and modes of operation; diffusion, confusion and mode choice.
d08-block-ciphers.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”，并知道异或。
d08-block-ciphers.prereq_en: Foundations & Terminology and XOR recommended first.
outcomes_zh: 说明分组、密钥、轮函数与工作模式的分工。
比较 ECB、CBC、CTR、GCM 的行为与风险。
用扩散与混淆解释 AES 的设计目标。
outcomes_en: Explain the roles of block size, key, round function and mode.
Compare ECB, CBC, CTR and GCM behaviour and risks.
Use diffusion and confusion to explain AES design goals.
d08-block-ciphers.project_zh: 对同一段明文分别用 ECB 与 CBC 加密一张图片，比较泄露的结构。
d08-block-ciphers.project_en: Encrypt the same image with ECB and CBC and compare the structures leaked.

d09-hashes.desc_en: Hash functions and message digests: one-wayness, collision resistance, avalanche effect and password derivation.
d09-hashes.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”。
outcomes_zh: 区分原像、第二原像与碰撞三种安全性质。
解释生日攻击为什么与输出长度有关。
说明口令派生为什么要加盐并使用慢哈希。
outcomes_en: Distinguish preimage, second-preimage and collision security.
Explain why birthday attacks depend on output length.
Explain why password derivation uses salt and a slow hash.
d09-hashes.project_zh: 比较 SHA-256 与一个慢口令哈希在同一份口令上的时间与内存成本。
d09-hashes.project_en: Compare SHA-256 and a slow password hash on the same password in time and memory cost.

d10-auth-aead.desc_en: MAC and AEAD: GCM, Poly1305, and the order of encrypt and authenticate.
d10-auth-aead.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“哈希”和“对称分组密码”。
d10-auth-aead.prereq_en: Hash Functions and Symmetric Block Ciphers recommended first.
outcomes_zh: 说明 MAC 与数字签名的信任模型差异。
解释 AEAD 如何同时给机密性与完整性。
比较 encrypt-then-MAC 与 MAC-then-encrypt 的边界。
outcomes_en: Explain the trust-model difference between MAC and digital signature.
Explain how AEAD provides confidentiality and integrity together.
Compare the boundaries of encrypt-then-MAC and MAC-then-encrypt.
d10-auth-aead.project_zh: 为一个消息格式写出 nonce、AAD、密文与标签的布局，并说明失败时如何拒绝。
d10-auth-aead.project_en: Design the nonce, AAD, ciphertext and tag layout for a message format, and state how to reject on failure.

d11-asymmetric.desc_en: Public-key cryptography: RSA, ElGamal, elliptic curves and where lattice trapdoors come from.
d11-asymmetric.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”，知道模运算。
d11-asymmetric.prereq_en: Foundations & Terminology and modular arithmetic recommended first.
outcomes_zh: 说明公钥加密解决的是密钥分发而不是身份本身。
区分 RSA 的大整数分解与 Diffie-Hellman 的离散对数假设。
解释椭圆曲线为什么在同等安全下密钥更短。
outcomes_en: Explain that public-key encryption solves key distribution, not identity by itself.
Distinguish RSA integer factorisation from Diffie-Hellman discrete-log assumptions.
Explain why elliptic curves give shorter keys at equal security.
d11-asymmetric.project_zh: 用一个小参数跑通 RSA 的密钥生成、加密、解密，并说明哪些参数绝对不能用于生产。
d11-asymmetric.project_en: Run RSA key generation, encryption and decryption with small parameters, and state which parameters are never safe in production.

d12-signatures.desc_en: Digital signatures: signing, verification, blind, ring and threshold signatures and their trust boundaries.
d12-signatures.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“非对称公钥”和“哈希”。
d12-signatures.prereq_en: Asymmetric Public-key and Hash Functions recommended first.
outcomes_zh: 说明签名与 MAC 的能力差异。
解释盲签名、环签名、门限签名各自隐藏或分散什么。
识别“签名等于身份认证”的常见误用。
outcomes_en: Explain the capability difference between signatures and MACs.
Explain what blind, ring and threshold signatures hide or distribute.
Spot the common misuse of treating a signature as identity authentication.
d12-signatures.project_zh: 为一个软件更新流程设计签名与验签步骤，并写出密钥泄露后的回滚方案。
d12-signatures.project_en: Design signing and verification for a software update flow, including rollback after key compromise.

d13-key-management.desc_en: Key management: generation, distribution, rotation, revocation and escrow; often harder than the algorithm.
d13-key-management.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”。
outcomes_zh: 列出一个密钥从生成到销毁的完整生命周期。
解释轮换、撤销与托管各自的威胁模型。
说明 HSM/TPM 解决的是密钥隔离，不是算法本身。
outcomes_en: List a key's full lifecycle from generation to destruction.
Explain the threat models of rotation, revocation and escrow.
Explain that HSM/TPM provide key isolation, not algorithm security by themselves.
d13-key-management.project_zh: 为一个组织写密钥清单：用途、持有人、轮换周期、撤销方式、备份位置。
d13-key-management.project_en: Write a key inventory for an organisation: purpose, holder, rotation period, revocation method and backup location.

d14-protocols-pki.desc_en: Protocols and PKI: TLS, certificates, ACME, Kerberos and defences against man-in-the-middle attacks.
d14-protocols-pki.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“非对称公钥”“数字签名”。
d14-protocols-pki.prereq_en: Asymmetric Public-key and Digital Signatures recommended first.
outcomes_zh: 说明 TLS 握手在认证、密钥交换与记录层各自做什么。
读懂证书链、CA、SAN、吊销与 ACME 的关系。
解释降级攻击与中间人攻击的防线。
outcomes_en: Explain what TLS handshake does for authentication, key exchange and record protection.
Read the relationships among certificate chain, CA, SAN, revocation and ACME.
Explain defences against downgrade and man-in-the-middle attacks.
d14-protocols-pki.project_zh: 用一张手绘时序图说明 TLS 1.3 握手，并标出三个必须验证的检查点。
d14-protocols-pki.project_en: Draw a sequence diagram for a TLS 1.3 handshake and mark three checks that must be verified.

d15-zkp.desc_en: Zero-knowledge proofs: completeness, soundness, zero knowledge and the Fiat-Shamir heuristic.
d15-zkp.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”，知道承诺的概念更好。
outcomes_zh: 说出零知识证明的完备性、可靠性与零知识三性。
解释交互式证明如何经 Fiat-Shamir 变成非交互。
区分“证明知道”与“证明某件事为真”。
outcomes_en: State completeness, soundness and zero knowledge.
Explain how Fiat-Shamir turns an interactive proof non-interactive.
Distinguish proving knowledge from proving a statement true.
d15-zkp.project_zh: 用一个小型图同构例子讲清交互式零知识证明的三轮消息。
d15-zkp.project_en: Use a small graph-isomorphism example to explain the three messages of an interactive zero-knowledge proof.

d16-secret-sharing-mpc.desc_en: Secret sharing and MPC: Shamir thresholds, garbled circuits and the trust assumptions of multi-party computation.
d16-secret-sharing-mpc.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”，知道有限域更好。
d16-secret-sharing-mpc.prereq_en: Foundations & Terminology recommended; finite fields help.
outcomes_zh: 解释 (t,n) 门限共享的恢复条件。
说明 MPC 要隐藏的是输入，不只是输出。
区分混淆电路、秘密共享与同态加密的适用场景。
outcomes_en: Explain the recovery condition of (t,n) threshold sharing.
Explain that MPC hides inputs, not only outputs.
Distinguish use cases for garbled circuits, secret sharing and homomorphic encryption.
d16-secret-sharing-mpc.project_zh: 用 5 份共享、门限 3 的例子手算一次秘密恢复，并说明两份为什么不够。
d16-secret-sharing-mpc.project_en: Hand-compute secret recovery with 5 shares and threshold 3, and explain why two shares are insufficient.

d17-side-channel.desc_en: Side-channel and physical attacks: timing, power, cache, fault injection and acoustic leakage.
d17-side-channel.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“对称分组密码”和“非对称公钥”。
d17-side-channel.prereq_en: Symmetric Block Ciphers and Asymmetric Public-key recommended first.
outcomes_zh: 说明侧信道攻击利用的是实现泄露，不是数学漏洞。
解释常量时间实现与盲化各自防什么。
区分时序、功耗、缓存、故障注入的攻击入口。
outcomes_en: Explain that side channels exploit implementation leakage, not mathematical flaws.
Explain what constant-time code and blinding each defend against.
Distinguish entry points for timing, power, cache and fault attacks.
d17-side-channel.project_zh: 对一个比较循环写常量时间版本，并用计时实验说明差异被压低。
d17-side-channel.project_en: Write a constant-time version of a comparison loop and use a timing experiment to show the difference is reduced.

d18-steganography.desc_en: Steganography and information hiding: embedding a message in a carrier is not the same as encryption.
d18-steganography.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”。
outcomes_zh: 说清隐写隐藏“存在”，加密隐藏“内容”。
解释 LSB 嵌入与载体统计的关系。
区分隐写分析与密码分析的目标。
outcomes_en: Explain that steganography hides existence while encryption hides content.
Explain the relationship between LSB embedding and carrier statistics.
Distinguish the goals of steganalysis and cryptanalysis.
d18-steganography.project_zh: 在一张图片的 LSB 中嵌入一段短文本，再用卡方检验观察统计变化。
d18-steganography.project_en: Embed a short text in an image's LSBs and use a chi-square test to observe statistical changes.

d19-randomness.desc_en: Randomness and CSPRNG: seed, entropy source, pseudorandomness and predictability.
d19-randomness.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”。
outcomes_zh: 区分 TRNG、CSPRNG 与普通 PRNG。
解释种子泄露如何让输出可预测。
说明熵源不足为什么会让密钥生成失效。
outcomes_en: Distinguish TRNG, CSPRNG and ordinary PRNG.
Explain how seed leakage makes output predictable.
Explain why insufficient entropy breaks key generation.
d19-randomness.project_zh: 写一个失败案例：固定种子生成会话密钥，说明攻击者如何复现。
d19-randomness.project_en: Write a failure case: generate a session key from a fixed seed and explain how an attacker reproduces it.

d20-china-sm.desc_en: China's national cryptography: SM2, SM3, SM4, SM9 and an entry into the standard system.
d20-china-sm.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“非对称公钥”“哈希”“对称分组密码”。
d20-china-sm.prereq_en: Asymmetric Public-key, Hash Functions and Symmetric Block Ciphers recommended first.
outcomes_zh: 把 SM2/SM3/SM4/SM9 对应到公钥、哈希、分组、标识密码。
说明国密标准与算法实现不是同一层。
读懂一个国密应用场景的算法选择。
outcomes_en: Map SM2/SM3/SM4/SM9 to public-key, hash, block cipher and identity-based cryptography.
Explain that standards and implementations are different layers.
Read the algorithm choices in a Chinese national-cryptography application.
d20-china-sm.project_zh: 画一张 SM2/SM3/SM4 在某个应用中的调用关系图，并注明标准编号。
d20-china-sm.project_en: Draw how SM2/SM3/SM4 are called in one application and cite the standard numbers.

d21-quantum-crypto.desc_en: Quantum cryptography: BB84, quantum key distribution, quantum threats and quantum resources.
d21-quantum-crypto.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”，知道量子态不可克隆即可。
d21-quantum-crypto.prereq_en: Foundations & Terminology recommended; no-cloning is enough to start.
outcomes_zh: 用 BB84 说明测量扰动如何暴露窃听。
区分 QKD 与量子计算对经典密码的威胁。
说明 QKD 仍需要认证信道。
outcomes_en: Use BB84 to explain how measurement disturbance reveals eavesdropping.
Distinguish QKD from the threat quantum computing poses to classical cryptography.
Explain that QKD still needs an authenticated channel.
d21-quantum-crypto.project_zh: 用四个量子态画一次 BB84 密钥协商，并标出窃听者可能被发现的步骤。
d21-quantum-crypto.project_en: Draw one BB84 key exchange with four quantum states and mark where an eavesdropper can be detected.

d22-post-quantum.desc_en: Post-quantum cryptography: Kyber, Falcon, McEliece and migration routes.
d22-post-quantum.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“非对称公钥”和“哈希”。
d22-post-quantum.prereq_en: Asymmetric Public-key and Hash Functions recommended first.
outcomes_zh: 区分基于格、编码、哈希的后量子方案。
说明 Kyber/ML-KEM 与 Falcon/ML-DSA 的角色。
写出“先收集、后解密”的迁移理由。
outcomes_en: Distinguish lattice-, code- and hash-based post-quantum schemes.
Explain the roles of Kyber/ML-KEM and Falcon/ML-DSA.
State the harvest-now-decrypt-later reason for migration.
d22-post-quantum.project_zh: 为一个 TLS 服务写后量子混合密钥交换的迁移清单，标出兼容性风险。
d22-post-quantum.project_en: Write a migration checklist for post-quantum hybrid key exchange in a TLS service and mark compatibility risks.

d23-applied-security.desc_en: Applied security engineering: passwords, phishing, storage, TEE, supply chain and real systems.
d23-applied-security.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“协议与 PKI”“哈希”。
d23-applied-security.prereq_en: Protocols & PKI and Hash Functions recommended first.
outcomes_zh: 把一个真实系统拆成认证、授权、存储、更新四层。
说明口令、钓鱼、供应链攻击各自的入口。
区分 TEE、沙箱、最小权限提供的保证。
outcomes_en: Break a real system into authentication, authorisation, storage and update layers.
Explain entry points for password, phishing and supply-chain attacks.
Distinguish the guarantees of TEE, sandboxing and least privilege.
d23-applied-security.project_zh: 对一个登录流程做威胁建模，列出五个最可能失效的环节和验证方法。
d23-applied-security.project_en: Threat-model a login flow and list five likely failure points with verification methods.

d24-theory.desc_en: Theoretical foundations: computational hardness, reductions, provable security and cryptographic models.
d24-theory.prereq_zh: 建议先完成“基础与术语”，并具备概率与算法基础。
d24-theory.prereq_en: Foundations & Terminology plus basic probability and algorithms recommended.
outcomes_zh: 说明“可证明安全”证明的是归约，不是绝对安全。
区分信息论安全与计算安全。
读懂一个归约证明的挑战者与攻击者角色。
outcomes_en: Explain that provable security proves a reduction, not absolute security.
Distinguish information-theoretic from computational security.
Read the challenger and adversary roles in a reduction proof.
d24-theory.project_zh: 选一个简单方案，写出“如果攻破它就能解决某个困难问题”的归约草图。
d24-theory.project_en: Take a simple scheme and sketch a reduction: breaking it solves a hard problem.
